page.title: Paychecks
page.intro: Your pay schedules and when you expect to get paid. Expected only; not included in your totals.
page.acknowledgeCreate: I checked my pay schedules. Let me try again

manual.heading: Add a pay schedule
manual.intro: You’re setting this up yourself. It isn’t based on deposits or confirmed by your employer.

groups.locked: Finish or cancel the open action before closing this group.

profiles.heading: Your paychecks
profiles.emptyBody: Review a possible paycheck below or add a pay schedule manually. A deposit alone is not a confirmed paycheck.

candidates.heading: Possible paychecks
candidates.intro: Review the deposits before confirming a pay schedule.
candidates.none: No possible paychecks to review. You can still add a pay schedule manually.
candidates.dismissedIntro: Dismissal applies to the exact evidence reviewed. Review a possible paycheck again to look at it once more.
candidates.dismissedLocked: Dismissed possible paychecks stay open while a decision is saving.

card.basedOnVariable: Based on {{total}} deposits. Observed history, not an expected range.
card.noWindowActive: No expected window is available. Expected, not guaranteed.
card.noWindowPaused: Paused pay schedules have no active expected window.
card.noWindowEnded: Ended pay schedules have no active expected window.
card.scheduleNote: To change the pay dates, end this pay schedule and add a new one. Its linked deposits stay with it.

facts.sameAmount: The same amount in each deposit
facts.variableAmount: Variable · lower median {{amount}}. This history is not an expected range.

actions.endPrompt: End {{name}}? Its expected paychecks will stop. The pay schedule and its linked deposits stay, and you can turn it back on.

evidence.none: No linked deposits. This is your saved pay schedule.
evidence.edited: Edited since this deposit was linked. The pay schedule is unchanged.
evidence.removePrompt: Remove this paycheck link? The deposit will remain in Transactions.

receipt.label: Deposit to link to {{name}}
receipt.heading: Link a deposit
receipt.intro: Link a deposit you received to this pay schedule. Its expected amount and dates don’t change.
receipt.loadError: We couldn’t load your deposits. Cancel and try again.

warnings.dateOutsideWindow: Date is outside this paycheck’s expected dates. You can still record the actual deposit date.
warnings.amountNeedsReview: Exact amount unavailable. Linking by deposit ID won’t change the pay schedule.
warnings.expectedAmountNeedsReview: Exact expected amount unavailable. Recording the actual amount won’t change the pay schedule.
warnings.differsFromFixed: Amount differs from the fixed expected amount. You can still record the actual amount.
warnings.expectedRangeNeedsReview: Exact expected range unavailable. Recording the actual amount won’t change the pay schedule.
warnings.outsideRange: Amount is outside the expected range. You can still record the actual amount.

cashInErrors.amount: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals, up to 9999999999999999.99.

form.manualNote: Create an active pay schedule for your expected paycheck. You’re setting this up yourself; it isn’t confirmed by your employer.
form.confirmScheduleNote: Review and accept this schedule unchanged. To use a different schedule, create a pay schedule manually.
form.editScheduleNote: The pay dates can’t be edited. End this pay schedule and add a new one to change them. Its linked deposits stay with it.
form.variableNote: Observed amounts vary. Enter the minimum and maximum you explicitly accept; observed bounds are not filled in.
form.unsafeAmountNote: This amount could not be loaded with reliable cent precision. Enter the exact amount you accept before saving.
form.submitError: The action could not be completed. Check the page message before trying again.

errors.display_name_invalid: Enter a display name of 1 to 500 characters.
errors.anchor_kind_invalid: Choose a day of month or month end.
errors.anchor_day_invalid: Enter a whole day from 1 to 30, or choose month end.
errors.reference_date_invalid: Enter a valid reference anchor date.
errors.semimonthly_pair_invalid: Choose ordered anchors at least seven days apart, including across February's month boundary.
errors.window_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 3.
errors.amount_mode_invalid: Variable evidence requires an explicit amount range.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals, up to 9999999999999999.99.
errors.range_order_invalid: Maximum amount must be greater than minimum amount.

feedback.loadFailed: Paychecks could not be loaded. Refresh to try again; the displayed information may be out of date.
feedback.uncertainCreate: We could not confirm whether the pay schedule was created. Refresh and check the saved pay schedules before intentionally trying again.
feedback.uncertainWrite: We could not confirm the outcome of this action. Refresh and check the current state before trying again.
feedback.uncertainCreateLoaded: Paychecks loaded. Check the saved pay schedules before intentionally trying to create another pay schedule.
feedback.uncertainReceiptLoaded: Paychecks loaded. Check the linked deposits before intentionally linking another deposit.

notices.dismissed: Candidate dismissed. You can review it again below.
notices.reconsidered: Candidate returned to your review list.
notices.receiptRecorded: Deposit linked to this pay schedule.
notices.receiptRemoved: Paycheck link removed. The deposit remains in Transactions.

errors.authentication_required: Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage paychecks.
errors.paycheck_not_found: That pay schedule is no longer available. Review the current pay schedules.
errors.candidate_changed: This candidate changed or is no longer available. Review the latest evidence before trying again.
errors.candidate_dismissed: This candidate was dismissed. Review it again before confirming.
errors.confirmation_conflict: The evidence changed during confirmation. Review the latest evidence before trying again.
errors.candidate_schedule_mismatch: The candidate schedule cannot be changed. Review it again or create a pay schedule manually.
errors.fingerprint_invalid: This candidate can no longer be reviewed. Refresh the candidates.
errors.algorithm_version_invalid: This candidate version is invalid. Refresh the candidates.
errors.name_invalid: Enter a nonblank paycheck name of 500 characters or fewer.
errors.schedule_invalid: Enter a complete, valid paycheck schedule.
errors.timing_invalid: Enter whole timing windows from zero to three days.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter a positive fixed amount or increasing range, with at most two decimal places.
errors.paycheck_not_active: Only an active paycheck can link a new deposit.
errors.receipt_slot_unavailable: That paycheck date is no longer available. Review the refreshed pay schedule.
errors.receipt_source_invalid: Choose either a new deposit or a saved deposit.
errors.receipt_inflow_invalid: Enter a valid description, positive amount, and date.
errors.receipt_inflow_unavailable: That deposit is unavailable or already linked. Review the refreshed deposits.
errors.receipt_conflict: That deposit changed or is already linked. Check the updated pay schedule.
errors.receipt_link_protected: Confirmation-history links cannot be removed here.
errors.receipt_date_invalid: The observed date is too far from the selected paycheck date.
errors.request_invalid: Check the form fields and try again.
errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Try again.
